My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I came across the BMC Firmware Engineer opening at Maxonic and wanted to reach out directly. I recently completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT (May 2026), with hands-on experience in bare-metal C firmware, I2C/SPI/UART protocols, FreeRTOS, and embedded Linux.

A few highlights: STM32 Cortex-M4 firmware at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM with interrupt-driven ADC and I2C drivers from scratch; FreeRTOS-based task coordination with UART communication and VL53L0X ToF sensor integration; PCB design and hardware-firmware debugging with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.

I would love to connect and learn more about the role. I am attaching my resume for your reference and happy to chat at your convenience.
